# Rahul Chanda Photography
> Premium commercial product photography studio based in Dehradun, India. Specializing in product photography, fashion & lifestyle, food & beverage, commercial campaigns, brand content creation, and architectural photography.

## Navigation

- [Home](https://rahulchandaphotography.netlify.app/): Single-page portfolio with hero, about, services showcase, testimonials, and contact.
- [Pricing](/pricing.md): Machine-readable pricing information.

## Sections (on home page)

1. **Hero** — Full-screen video introduction. Photographer name and tagline.
2. **About** — Photographer bio, experience, awards, and philosophy.
3. **Design in Motion** — 3D cinematic cylinder carousel showcasing featured portfolio work.
4. **Services** — Six photography services with full descriptions, deliverables, and pricing.
5. **Testimonials** — Client reviews and testimonials carousel.
6. **Contact** — Booking inquiry form with social links.

## Key Details

- **Location:** Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India
- **Specialty:** Commercial product, food & beverage, fashion, and architectural photography
- **Experience:** 10+ years
- **Studio:** Controlled studio environment with professional lighting and styling
- **Formats:** RAW + retouched files, web-optimized variants, usage rights included
- **Pricing range:** ₹20,000 - ₹40,000+ per project (starting)
